::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 4th [?1870]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Caroline Fairclough/23
:::

My dear [Arthur](people/person_238.qmd)
I shall put your corrections in, I always <u>had</u> I confess believed that Bombastes was in [Hudibras](other_books/otherbook_789.qmd), but I ought not to have done so, as I never read it.

As to the <u>Rod</u> being a Celtic word, I did not make away with that because I thought it was curious that the sound should suggest the same idea independently or perhaps by some lingering of the root in the old Italian dialects.

But I really believed in both Brag and the bambyx, and I am very sorry I was all wrong.

Thank you
yours very sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** It is not easy to identify the chapter of ‘Polyglot Parsing’ referred to here and it may not have been published.
